Subject: Aster Labs — vendor onboarding and PO routing details

Hi Dana,

Thanks again for the call this morning. To get Aster Labs into our vendor master and enable PO issuance, please can you return the attached onboarding form with the following items completed/provided:

- Legal entity name (exactly as registered)
- Tax ID / W-9 (US vendors) or tax certificate if non-US
- Registered address and remit address (if different)
- Primary AP contact name, email, and phone
- Preferred PO email for receiving purchase orders (we can send to ops@asterlabs.com by default)
- ACH bank details (bank letter or voided check) and account name
- Remittance instructions and any invoice routing rules

I attached a blank redwood_vendor_onboarding_form_2027.pdf — completing that will speed things up. If you prefer, you can reply with the attachments directly. Once we receive everything, I’ll open the vendor master record and confirm the ERP code and PO channel.

Target: aim to have the vendor active for POs by Mon Apr 26 if we have the docs by end of week.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Vendor Onboarding Manager
